Keep a step's wanted columns and drop rows that carry only keys

Source: R/fiss_parse.R
knw_fiss_select.Rd

Takes the key columns, the step's columns (see knw_fiss_columns()) and every column whose name contains "comment", and adds a wanted column the sheet lacks as NA. The template pre-fills the reference number and names on hundreds of blank entry rows, so a row is kept only when at least one non-key cell is filled.

Usage

knw_fiss_select(df, step, cols = knw_fiss_columns()$wanted)

Arguments

df

data.frame, a step's rows as knw_fiss_read_step() returns them in data.

step

string, the step (see knw_fiss_match_sheet()).

cols

list, the columns read per step, with keys read on every step; by default knw_fiss_columns()$wanted. Add a name to read a column the default does not.

Value

df's wanted columns, then any other comment columns, with the key-only rows dropped.

Examples

df <- data.frame(reference_number = c("1", "2"), gazetted_name = "Test Creek",
                 utm_zone = c("10", NA), utm_easting = c("612000", NA),
                 utm_northing = c("5980000", NA), site_comments = c(NA, NA))
# row 2 carries only keys
knw_fiss_select(df, "step1_ref_loc")
#>   reference_number gazetted_name utm_zone utm_easting utm_northing
#> 1                1    Test Creek       10      612000      5980000
#>   site_comments reach_number site_number local_name waterbody_id survey_date
#> 1            NA           NA          NA         NA           NA          NA
